neighbours.label: the word just before a currency adopted or devalued ('adopted the euro', 'depreciation of the ruble') or a sacred Christian term ('the Holy Spirit', 'the good news'), as against the same verbs with an everyday object
fire: After joining the union, Latvia adopted the euro in 2014.
The weakening of the rupee pushed up the price of imported oil.
The believers prayed to be filled with the Holy Spirit.
The preacher travelled from village to village to spread the good news.
A sharp devaluation of the peso followed the election.
Lithuania replaced its old currency when it adopted the euro.
Love and patience are gifts of the Holy Spirit, she told the class.
The fall of the lira made holidays in Italy cheaper for tourists.
quiet: After joining the club, Latvia adopted the new rules in 2014.
The weakening of the bridge pushed up the cost of repairs.
The children prayed before eating the evening meal.
The postman travelled from village to village to deliver the letters.
A sharp drop in the temperature followed the storm.
Lithuania replaced its old flag when it adopted the new design.
Love and patience are important in a classroom, she told the class.
The fall of the leaves made the park look golden for tourists.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.6 on 'the'/'of' before the currency or sacred term; the same verbs with ordinary objects below 0.05
